name: SSP Product Bundles for WooCommerce
author: stupidsimpleplugins

sections.description:
SSP Product Bundles for WooCommerce lets you create true WooCommerce bundle products that add only the selected component products to the cart while proportionally or individually pricing each item so the total matches the bundle price.

Main features:

  • Create dedicated Bundle products via WooCommerce → Bundles
  • Add multiple component products per bundle
  • Two pricing distribution modes:
    • Even split – auto-distributes bundle price across components
    • Custom per-item pricing – assign final per-item prices manually
  • Auto-sum helper – automatically totals per-item values into the bundle’s Regular or Sale price
  • Prevent duplicate bundles in the cart
  • Removing one item removes the entire bundle group
  • Bundles visually count as one item in cart/checkout (even if multiple items are included)
  • Optional compatibility toggle for third-party pricing/discount plugins
  • Automatically assigns bundles to a “Bundles” product category
  • No custom post types beyond standard WooCommerce product

Upsell Integration

For bundle-based upsell prompts triggered when shoppers add individual bundle items, this plugin integrates with:

https://www.stupidsimpleplugins.com/product/wo-upsell/

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external APIs, tracking systems, or perform license validation.

For transparency only:

  • Privacy Policy: https://www.stupidsimpleplugins.com/privacy-policy/

sections.installation:
1. Upload via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then activate
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Bundles
  3. Create a bundle, select components, and configure pricing

Bundles behave as standard WooCommerce products with enhanced cart logic.
sections.faq:
Can bundles be purchased like normal products?

Yes. Bundles are standard WooCommerce products and can be listed and sold normally.

Will customers see the bundle in the cart?

No. Only the component products appear, grouped under the bundle name.

Do discounts and coupons work?

Yes. Coupons apply normally. Third-party pricing plugins can be enabled via compatibility mode.

Does the plugin store customer data or send it externally?

No. All processing occurs locally in your WordPress/WooCommerce environment.

How do I enable upsell prompts?

Install SSP Woo Upsell using the link above. Bundle-based upsells are configured inside that plugin.
